hits.snippet: Ahrefsannounced Letaido on August 12, 2026, an agent-powered marketing workspace that lets teams execute multi-step tasks, automate recurring workflows, and monitor websites and competitors from a single shared environment, rather than through one-off chatbot conversations. [...] Where: Ahrefs is headquartered in Palo Alto, California, and the announcement targets marketing teams and agencies operating globally. Why: Ahrefs cited BCG's 2026 global CMO survey finding that only 32 percent of chief marketing officers have rebuilt how their marketing operations function around AI, with 42 percent still using generative AI only for isolated individual tasks. Letaido is positioned to close that gap, though it launches into a marketing technology sector where independent research, including KPMG and TransUnion data from August 2026, shows nearly half of organizations scaling back agentic AI investment over unclear returns, and where the underlying discipline of AI visibility optimization remains contested among researchers studying whether the techniques actually work.
